selection.deepcad: Reuse volume-eligible IDs from historical planned 50 test items in their saved order; fill any ineligible gap from other volume-eligible test IDs sorted then shuffled seed42. Never select on achieved quality.
selection.interior: Source-stratified random sample of manifest-marked volumes:40 IndoorCAD from95 marked,10 PolyHaven from23 marked. Within each stratum IDs sorted then shuffled seed42; verify each full STL volume and hash, skip rejected inputs and continue in the same pre-shuffled order until quota. Manifest flags alone do not establish eligibility.
selection.limitation: Protocol frozen after exploratory experiments, not a claim of untouched holdout. Original local DeepCAD dev/test split preserved; Interior300 has no official split.

shared_settings.input: same six-view target sheet, normalized extents, request and base system prompt for all three conditions; classic repair adds measured feedback

before_paid_run.status: resolved; settings frozen before first paid generation

metrics.primary: mean best full-volume IoU over all50 eligible targets per domain; exhausted/failed prediction unavailable treated0 in primary mean, also report availability
secondary: all provider-reported USD including failed generations and analysis if any
metrics.paired: Report per-ID first versus best difference and bootstrapped paired95%CI; first historical attempt is only a diagnostic proxy, not a separately randomized baseline
metrics.failures: Input eligibility fixed before generation; do not treat unprocessed or partial jobs as measured failures. Report incomplete coverage separately.

source_revisions.reason: increase independent worker concurrency from 2 to 4 and serialize budget lock acquisition; model prompts and geometry unchanged

execution_policy: Complete matched batches of five per domain with four independent workers. Next batch admitted using observed mean spend per matched rank plus $0.20 headroom, never quality. Each call reserves its entire output allowance; reservations wait for other calls to release unused capacity.
resource_failure_policy: Whole-worker watchdog termination during generated CadQuery execution is recorded as a failed execution attempt with the observed fixed 2048MiB limit; the paid response is retained. One-prompt ends with a failed output; harness may repair within its original five-generation limit. No generated code was manually edited and no memory limit was raised.

reporting_source_revisions.reason: Presentation expanded to required research structure, authors and mentor added, verified CadQuery example and updated speaker notes; experiment and metrics unchanged
Slide text shortened; cycle diagram now shows STL entry, preparation, reference mesh, feedback, execution error and final CAD exit. Experiment unchanged.
